Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA

05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California

* Keith Gardner, Mayor’s Excellence-In-Service
* George Solano, Manager of the Year
* Maia Hodge, Employee of the Year

Proclamation declaring Saturday, April 11, 2015, to be "Earth Day" in the City of Vista.

Resolution No. 2015- , Landscaping and Lighting District No. 1; and

CIP No. 8262 - 2014 Slurry Seal Project Change Order No. 1 (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , approving Change Order No. 1 to the construction contract with American Asphalt South, Inc.; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , amending the Capital Improvement Program Budget FY 2014/15.
C7.

CIP No. 8261 - Buena Outfall Odor Control Project - Joint Agreement with the City of Carlsbad for Construction, Operation and Maintenance (BSD)
C10.
Sewer Maintenance Program - Agreements for On-Call Cleaning, CCTV, Repair and Emergency Response Services (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , approving a job order contract with DownStream Services, Inc. for on-call sewer and storm drain cleaning, CCTV and emergency response services; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , approving a job order contract with Orion Construction Corporation for on-call sewer pipeline repair and emergency response services. ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Appeal of PC14-311, Optimist Club Little League Fields, 600 Optimist Way (CC)
This Public Hearing has been cancelled and will be rescheduled. A new public notice will be provided.
PH2.
Central Vista Business Improvement District (CVBID) Public Hearing (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive public testimony regarding the proposed FY 2015/16 levy of assessments on businesses within the CVBID; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , confirming the CVBID FY 2015/16 annual report and levying the assessments for FY 2015/16.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
